headline: Old Dominion and James Madison finish level at the top
dek: James Madison beat Old Dominion in their only conference meeting and still could not pull clear of it. Old Dominion has conceded 14 goals all season, and in November it beat Georgia State, Marshall, App State and South Alabama.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Louisiana's 45 goals are more than any of James Madison, Old Dominion and App State has scored, and each of them sits above it in the table: scoring has not set this conference's order.

wire.line: Ginny Lackey has scored 16 of James Madison's 32 goals this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches are past their date with no published result, among them James Madison's trip to Virginia and its home match with Georgetown.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
